obernants.operator: On canonical runs, encode(decode(runs))=runs; on byte strings, decode(encode(bytes))=bytes with a sufficient budget. Thus both successful maps are injective on their stated domains. Error outputs have many antecedents.

obernants.operator: At each run test zero count then neighboring equality then checked length addition. Check output budget only after every run validates. Consequently later malformed runs take precedence over an earlier budget excess.
